title: INCISE: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation of Surgical Videos
abstract: arXiv:2611.26734v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Surgical video analysis requires video object segmentation (VOS), yet existing methods are commonly based on pretrained model fine-tuning using a large number of expert labels. In-context segmentation (ICS) offers the promise of bypassing this high cost by segmenting a target video using a few annotated references, which are the sole source of surgical knowledge for a frozen model. However, existing ICS methods tend to draw such references at random, which concentrate on a few views that dominate a surgical video and can miss other objects of interest (e.g., transient instruments and small structures). To address these challenges, we propose INCISE, a training-free ICS framework for surgical videos. INCISE selects unlabeled frames from multiple surgical videos that jointly cover the local appearances of a target video, and then segments the target video using these references. translated_title: INCISE：手术视频的免训练上下文分割
translated_abstract: 手术视频分析需要视频对象分割（VOS），然而现有方法通常依赖于使用大量专家标注对预训练模型进行微调。上下文分割（ICS）提供了绕过这一高昂成本的前景，即仅使用少量带标注的参考来分割目标视频，这些参考是冻结模型获取手术知识的唯一来源。然而，现有的ICS方法往往随机抽取参考，这些参考集中于主导手术视频的少数视图，可能遗漏其他感兴趣的对象（例如短暂出现的器械和小型结构）。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了INCISE，一个面向手术视频的免训练ICS框架。INCISE从多个手术视频中选择无标注帧，这些帧共同覆盖目标视频的局部外观，然后利用这些参考来分割目标视频。仅需选择并标注1.7%的训练帧即可……
tldr: INCISE是一个面向手术视频的免训练上下文分割框架，通过从多个手术视频中选择能共同覆盖目标视频局部外观的参考帧，仅需1.7%的标注帧即可实现分割，无需大规模专家标注和模型微调。
